ModMetaData.name: MFI Mystical Shaman Def Fix v3
ModMetaData.author: Alik
ModMetaData.description:
Prevents Vanilla Events Expanded from removing More Faction Interaction's MFI_MysticalShaman IncidentDef.
MFI keeps a hard reference to this incident and can throw a null-reference error when VEE disables/removes it through the event settings. Version 3 no longer replaces the XML Def, preserving its proper mod ownership and avoiding the VEE DefsAlterer static-constructor crash caused by version 2.
